page_title: LAZ 3-0 BOL | Lazio v Bologna 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' 3 - 0 Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) latches on to a killer pass deep inside the box and coolly puts the ball inside the right post!
90+1' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+1' Emil Holm (Bologna) is yellow-carded.
90+1' Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
88' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lazio.
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) is replacing Taty Castellanos.
84' Antonio Rapuano shows a yellow card to Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
83' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
82' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) but poses no threat.
81' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Santiago Castro will be replaced by Emil Holm (Bologna).
78' The current number of shots on goal is 3:1.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) comes onto the pitch so that Jens Odgaard can be given a rest.
74' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Remo Freuler and he is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
74' The substitution has been made. Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) has replaced Mattia Zaccagni.
72' 2 - 0 Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
68' 1 - 0 Samuel Gigot (Lazio) rises high to head the corner in the net and beyond the goalkeeper.
68' The ball is out of play. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner.
66' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Lazio players look gutted.
66' Lazio score a goal, but referee Antonio Rapuano has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
65' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Boulaye Dia (Lazio) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
63' Antonio Rapuano shows the yellow card to Samuel Gigot (Lazio) for a heavy challenge.
63' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for an infringement.

62' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Jens Odgaard (Bologna) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
60' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Boulaye Dia (Lazio) replacing Matias Vecino.
60' Here's the change. Pedro leaves the pitch and Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) comes on as a substitute.
59' Samuel Gigot (Lazio) is penalised for holding. Antonio Rapuano signals a set piece.
57' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity!
54' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
50' A pass lands at the feet of Taty Castellanos (Lazio) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
47' Pedro (Lazio) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Samuel Gigot (Lazio) replaces Alessio Romagnoli.
46' Half-time substitution. Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) is replaced by Nikola Moro.
46' Half-time substitution. Vincenzo Italiano decided to make a change. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is replaced by Kacper Urbanski.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+1' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Luca Pellegrini picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Lazio manage to earn a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Juan Miranda (Bologna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' Pedro (Lazio) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
38' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle. Santiago Castro (Bologna) commits a foul after dangerous play.

35' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Antonio Rapuano shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
34' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
31' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
29' Fine attempt! Santiago Castro (Bologna) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.

27' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
23' Today's referee Antonio Rapuano rightly decides to book Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) for his harsh tackle.
23' The referee blows his whistle as Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) was too aggressive in his challenge.

21' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Federico Ravaglia shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
20' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
19' Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul after Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
17' Handball by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio).
17' Pedro (Lazio) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
15' The ball is cleared after Pedro (Lazio) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
12' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post.
7' Matias Vecino (Lazio) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target.
5' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
3' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lazio will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Antonio Rapuano.
